source_refs.locator: One-based PDF pp. 1–2, climate context and regional modeling

evidence.scenario: Regional modeling gives 7–20% higher annual precipitation and 0.9–3.3°C warming by 2070; emissions pathway unspecified.
evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2026-02 reports: In southeastern Oruro and northern Potosí, models project drier dry seasons and wetter wet seasons with more floods and droughts; Quechua and Aymara highland farmers rely on rainfed or small-irrigation systems.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF p. 2, 2023 drought and livelihood impacts

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2026-02 reports: The report attributes the 2023 highland drought to climate-related heat and El Niño: water flows fell one-third, and crop losses affected nearly two million farmers across seven departments including Oruro and Potosí.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.
